meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT s.superhero_name,
       a.alignment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, a.alignment, s.weight_kg
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 3;

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH hero_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        SUM(attribute_value) AS total_score
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
ranked_heroes AS (
    SELECT 
        hero_id,
        total_score,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_score DESC) AS percentile_rank
    FROM hero_aggregates
)
SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN ranked_heroes r ON s.id = r.hero_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = 4 
  AND s.alignment_id = 1
ORDER BY r.percentile_rank DESC;

WITH luthor_info AS (
    SELECT publisher_id, alignment_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Lex Luthor'
),
hero_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        s.id AS hero_id,
        s.superhero_name,
        COALESCE(SUM(ha.attribute_value), 0) AS total_attribute_score
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN luthor_info li ON s.publisher_id = li.publisher_id AND s.alignment_id = li.alignment_id
    LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
    GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
)
SELECT superhero_name
FROM hero_scores
ORDER BY total_attribute_score DESC

FROM superhero sh

ORDER BY sh.superhero_name

    FROM "superhero" s

    WHERE a."alignment" = 'Good'

FROM "superhero" s
JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
CROSS JOIN cnt

           a.attribute_name,
           ha.attribute_value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.id ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC) AS rn
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
)

FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY superhero_name, attribute_value DESC;

questions.nlq: Hey! So our publishing company just updated the roster, and I need to pull together a report. Could you help me list all superheroes from our publisher with their power count and average attribute score, ranked by their power level? Oh and I'd love to see which ones have the 'Strength' or 'Intelligence' attributes highlighted separately!

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The user works for DC Comics (publisher_id = 4 in the publisher table). Their question about 'our publisher' specifically refers to DC Comics.
meanings.gt_sql:
WITH power_counts AS (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
attribute_avgs AS (
    SELECT hero_id, AVG(attribute_value) AS avg_attribute_score
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
),
strength_flags AS (
    SELECT hpa.hero_id, 1 AS has_strength
    FROM hero_attribute hpa
    JOIN attribute a ON hpa.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
),
intelligence_flags AS (
    SELECT hpi.hero_id, 1 AS has_intelligence
    FROM hero_attribute hpi
    JOIN attribute a ON hpi.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT 
    s.superhero_name,
    COALESCE(pc.power_count, 0) AS power_count,
    ROUND(aa.avg_attribute_score, 2) AS avg_attribute_score,
    COALESCE(sf.has_strength, 0) AS has_strength,
    COALESCE(ifl.has_intelligence, 0) AS has_intelligence
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN power_counts pc ON s.id = pc.hero_id
LEFT JOIN attribute_avgs aa ON s.id = aa.hero_id
LEFT JOIN strength_flags sf ON s.id = sf.hero_id
LEFT JOIN intelligence_flags ifl ON s.id = ifl.hero_id
WHERE p.id = 4
ORDER BY power_count DESC, superhero_name ASC

    s.superhero_name,
    COALESCE(pwr.power_count, 0) AS power_count,
    COALESCE(attr.avg_attribute_score, 0) AS avg_attribute_score,
    COALESCE(special.has_strength_intelligence, 0) AS has_strength_intelligence
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) pwr ON s.id = pwr.hero_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, AVG(attribute_value) AS avg_attribute_score
    FROM hero_attribute
    GROUP BY hero_id
) attr ON s.id = attr.hero_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT ha.hero_id,
           MAX(CASE WHEN a.attribute_name IN ('Strength', 'Intelligence') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_strength_intelligence
    FROM hero_attribute ha
    INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    GROUP BY ha.hero_id
) special ON s.id = special.hero_id
WHERE s.publisher_id = 3
ORDER BY power_count DESC;

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name, s.weight_kg
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.superhero_name, AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
GROUP BY s.id, s.superhero_name
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH dc_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.superhero_name, s.weight_kg
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT id, superhero_name
    FROM dc_heroes
    WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0
    ORDER BY weight_kg DESC
    LIMIT 3
)
SELECT t.superhero_name,
       AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM top3 t
LEFT JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.superhero_name;

LIMIT 3;

    JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
    WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
